design_fields.q1_rationale: The study states that plausible values were averaged, which does not meet the criteria for proper handling.
design_fields.q2_rationale: Matching text-readable full PDF has no explicit statement that ILSA sampling weights were omitted; weight references concern model parameters, outcome scaling, data variables or class/pixel weighting, not demonstrated sample-weight use.
design_fields.q3_rationale: The study does not mention using multilevel modeling or any method that accounts for school clustering.
design_fields.q4_rationale: The study mentions splitting the dataset into training and testing sets, indicating only internal validation methods were used.
